surface.$description: Explicit request 2026-09-12, "completely dark, from our token base": was {silver.900} (#2E2E2E), silver's own ramp bottoms out there with no darker step. black.900 (#1A1918) is the darkest primitive defined anywhere in Base-Primitives.json, and already used elsewhere in this same file (text.inverced, object-white.passive, shadow.middle) -- not a new value.

sidebar.$description: Reversed same day (explicit request, "make the color of sidebar darker than the surface" -- superseding the original "one step lighter" request a few messages earlier): black.950 (#000000, pure black, added to Base-Primitives.json specifically because black.900 -- bg.surface's own value -- was already the darkest primitive that existed). Matches Light theme's own existing relationship (bg.sidebar/silver.300 is already darker than bg.surface/silver.200 there), which this dark-theme value hadn't matched until now.

row-selected.$description: Dark counterpart chosen 2026-09-27 (no Figma dark source): one step above surface-pressed (silver.800, the hover fill) so selected stays distinct from hover, as light base.250 vs base.100

row-hover.$description: Explicit request 2026-09-30, "make the table row hover color black" (dark theme only): black.950 (#000000), darker than the dark surface (black.900, #1A1918). Tables only -- bg.surface-pressed itself is unchanged for the other components.

text-highlight.$description: Explicit request 2026-09-30, "make the CV's yellow highlight even darker, with white text" (dark theme): yellow.900 (#4E410E, darkest yellow step; first yellow.800, then "even darker") under text-active (#F4F3F1) -- a whole page of marked words no longer glares on the dark surface.

warning.$description: Explicit request 2026-09-28: was {orange.600}, identical to accent-1 in dark, so text-button's active and loading statuses could not be told apart. yellow.600 keeps warning yellow as in light and on the same .600 step as dark's system.error (red.600) and system.success (green.600).
